listing.name: Doom II (Crispy Doom family)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native source-port family with current executable packages. Limits: Maintained Doom-family source ports; separate executables and IWAD contracts per game, not Boom/ZDoom compatibility. Upstream platforms: Latest frozen7.2 Windows release ZIPs explicitly win64/x86-64, separately for Doom/Heretic/Hexen/Strife. macOS Homebrew/MacPorts and Linux distro/source routes; CPU follows selected package/build. Original data: Distinct from GZDoom #1824; split game data contracts and avoid counting engine binaries as new games. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
